title: CheckResult
description: What a post-deployment check Smith (mode check) writes to /work/out/result.json. The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate, then CheckResultHandler's rules: a bug on failed, a wake hint with exactly one key, a parsable at); the Smith checks it with check-result check. Strict types where the engine branches, any non-empty JSON where it only passes content on.

outcome.description: Branched on by the engine and the BPMN: passed ends the check, failed files a bug, not_yet runs it again later.

summary.description: What was checked and what it showed; for not_yet, why the check's conditions are not met yet.

bug.description: For failed only: the bug the engine files in the ticket's repo.

wake.description: For not_yet only, optional: when to look again. Exactly one of at and event.

event.description: A bus frame to wake on: <type> or <type>:<field>=<value>, over engine/docs/events.md's frame types, e.g. push:default=true or intake:name=question.

content.description: Passed on to a brief, a bug or a conversation entry, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.
